overview: Clinical notes from the MVP note pool and DAS_agent results for a KOMAP-positive rheumatoid arthritis cohort on KDI.

sections.title: Cohort and coverage
items: 1,987 KOMAP-positive RA patients and about 3.5 million notes, with coverage through September 30, 2024. The reported 90% positive predictive value (PPV) refers to patient selection. Austin records the selection rule as “cutoff - 1.387 ppv90%”. Confirm the sign and comparison rule with Austin before reproducing the cohort.

sections.title: Notes prepared for the agent
items: The source note pool was stored in Snappy-compressed Parquet. The prepared JSON and Parquet files group 30 patients per file.
Documented fields are MVPCore_ID, TiuDocumentSID, EpisodeBeginDateTime and ScrubbedText.

sections.title: Agent output files
items: tags.csv records whether a note is informative or non-informative. results.csv lists existing_DAS_score, calculated_das_score, calculated_das_category, TiuDocumentSID and evidences.
Match TiuDocumentSID in results.csv to TiuDocumentSID in the notes to find the source document.

sections.title: Disease activity scores
items: existing_DAS_score is a score recorded in the note. calculated_das_score is calculated from the note when the required information is available.
As clarified in the project discussion, an informative note can receive a calculated_das_category even when calculated_das_score is blank.

The boundaries are 2.5 between remission and low, 3.2 between low and moderate, and 5.1 between moderate and high. Austin’s README does not specify which category includes a score exactly at a boundary.

sections.title: Chart review
items: Agent results were compared with human chart review on 187 notes. The README gives no numerical performance estimate.

sections.title: Access
items: KDI access is required. KDI is the documented storage platform.

sections.title: Reading a file
items: Use pyarrow.parquet.read_table to select columns from a Parquet file, then call to_pandas(). The README includes a separate pandas example for writing a Parquet file.
